title: Decoding candidate set
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let a long-code table and a real parameter $\\varepsilon$ be given, and fix a vertex $v$. The decoding candidate set at $v$ is the union of the notable-coordinate set at $v$ and the neighbor notable-coordinate set at $v$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
A long-code table on the vertices of $G$
